{{Top|leg}}
'''Interloper Squadron''', along with [[Stranger Squadron]], was one of two [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] that was dispatched by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Broak Vessery]], under orders from the "real" [[Ysanne Isard]], to rescue [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] from the trap set by [[Prince-Admiral/Legends|Prince-Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]] at the [[Battle of Distna]]. The squadron included [[Interloper Eight]] and [[Interloper Twelve]].
